title: error — Error Notification
description: Server sends an error notification. Clients should branch on 'code' (not 'message') for logic; use 'message' for debug display only. See ws-protocol-design.md §4.3 for the complete error code table.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. See §4.3 error code table. Categories: 1xxx=general, 2xxx=auth/session, 3xxx=bandwidth/media, 4xxx=client-timeout.

message.description: Human-readable error description. For debugging only — client logic MUST branch on 'code', not this field.

fatal.description: true = session will terminate. Client should stop sending and prepare for reconnection.

recoverable.description: true = client may retry automatically (e.g., lower video quality, refresh token).
